title: Removal of the Inboard Flap Carriage Roller and Bearing Assembly

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the roller and bearing assembly from the inboard flap carriage with the flap extended, including the wear measurement of the roller and the track that decides the next action.

sections.purpose: This task removes the roller and bearing assembly from the inboard flap carriage so that the roller can be renewed and the track running surface can be measured for wear.
sections.job_setup_note: The flap must be extended to the maintenance position and supported. Hydraulic power must be off and the flap system tagged. Measure the roller diameter and the track surface at the three marked positions before removal, because the pair is assessed together and a worn track will destroy a new roller within a few hundred cycles.
sections.procedure: 1. Extend the flaps to the maintenance position and support them on the trestle set. 2. Remove hydraulic power and put the warning notices in the flight compartment. WARNING: THE CARRIAGE CAN MOVE ALONG THE TRACK UNDER ITS OWN WEIGHT WHEN THE ROLLER IS RELEASED. FIT THE CARRIAGE RESTRAINT BEFORE YOU START. 3. Open the trailing edge access panels in zones 562, 565 and 662. 4. Clean the track and the roller and measure the roller diameter at three positions. 5. Measure the track surface profile at the three marked positions with the profile gauge and record the readings. CAUTION: RECORD THE TRACK READINGS BEFORE YOU REMOVE THE ROLLER. THE PROFILE GAUGE CANNOT BE SEATED CORRECTLY ONCE THE CARRIAGE IS SLACK. 6. Remove the screws LN714541-64 and the bearing cover. 7. Remove the bolts AGS968429-4D from the carriage pivot. 8. Move the hose GR458189-31 clear of the roller envelope and support it. 9. Where the obsolete clamp D2750134424647 is fitted, remove it and do not refit it. 10. Withdraw the roller and bearing assembly and put it on a clean surface. 11. Do a detailed visual inspection of the track surface for pitting and record the extent of any damage.
sections.close_out: Bag and label the removed fasteners. Protect the open bearing bore with a cap. Leave the flap on the trestles, the carriage restraint fitted and the warning notices in place. Record the roller diameter and the track profile readings against the aircraft and compare them with the previous set.

safety_precautions: Support the flap on the trestle set before you release the roller.
Fit the carriage restraint before removal.
Remove hydraulic power and tag the flap system.
Wear gloves when you handle the greased bearing.
